combo.tools: V / T / A / R / O / L

key.copyPaste: Copy / paste objects (works across layout documents)
key.delete: Delete objects; in figure editing this hides the element instead (restorable)
key.enter: Edit the selection: text enters editing, parameterizable panels enter figure editing
key.escape: Step out one level: text editing → figure element → editing mode → clear selection
key.newline: Insert a line break; plain ⏎ commits
key.script: Superscript / subscript (inside the properties panel's text box)
key.tools: Select / text / arrow / rectangle / ellipse / line
key.zEnds: Bring to front / send to back
key.multiSelect: Add / remove objects or figure elements from the selection
key.quickEdit: Open the quick-edit menu for the object
key.tutorialPause: Pause the tutorial (when the tutorial card has focus)
key.cycleOverlap: Cycle the selection through overlapping figure elements (both axes of a twin-axis plot)
